newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RUGBY UNION-Ralph may be fit to play in Rugby Sevens.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-Ralph may be fit to play in Rugby Sevens.

text.p: HONG KONG, March 21 - Bay of Plenty's Caleb Ralph passed a fitness test this morning and could start for the New Zealand team in this afternoon's Rugby World Cup Sevens pool matches against Japan and Tonga, NZPA reports.
An ankle injury had clouded the 19-year-old winger's prospects of playing in the tournament and Wellington's Alama Ieremia was flown to Hong Kong as a standby.
Team physiotherapist Rob Cashman said Ralph had responded to overnight treatment and it appeared that he could be playing.
